Demonstrated experience preparing educational programs and performing audits.
Demonstrated experience reviewing and revising transactional documents such as Business Associate Agreements and Data Use Agreements.

Support the privacy compliance functions of the Office of Compliance Services through investigations, regulatory guidance, auditing, education, and privacy risk management. As the Privacy Analyst, you will evaluate privacy incidents, interpret applicable laws and regulations, assess organizational practices, and advise departments on requirements involving protected health information and other sensitive information. This role works closely with operational departments, Information Security, Legal Affairs, Human Resources, Audit Advisory Services, and other stakeholders to strengthen compliance with HIPAA, CMIA, University of California and UCLA Health privacy policies, and other applicable privacy requirements.

Conduct and support privacy incident reviews and investigations, including gathering and analyzing documentation, participating in interviews, maintaining investigative workpapers, preparing reports, and assisting with mitigation, corrective actions, and reporting obligations.

Review policies, procedures, workflows, agreements, Data Use Agreements, access requests, and other business practices to identify privacy risks, recommend revisions, and support appropriate use, disclosure, access, and safeguarding of protected health information.
Research and interpret federal and state privacy laws and emerging regulatory requirements, and provide guidance to departments and stakeholders on complex privacy compliance matters.

Conduct privacy audits, access reviews, monitoring activities, and targeted compliance reviews; prepare findings and recommendations, track corrective actions, and support improvements to auditing and monitoring processes.
Develop, coordinate, and deliver privacy education and training, including targeted education based on findings from investigations, audits, monitoring activities, and regulatory changes.

Develop guidance documents, job aids, reports, monitoring tools, presentations, and other resources that strengthen the Privacy Compliance Program and support compliance committees and organizational leadership.

Collaborate with operational departments, Audit Advisory Services, Information Security, Legal Affairs, Human Resources, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders on privacy investigations, compliance initiatives, remediation efforts, and organizational privacy practices.
Demonstrated expertise conducting investigations, interviewing witnesses, and preparing investigation reports.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to conduct effective and accurate regulatory research and analysis.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively while establishing and maintaining effective professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage difficult and sensitive situations, prioritize multiple responsibilities, and effectively manage fluctuating workload demands.
